description.value: A controlled fMRI study of fear extinction circuitry in medication-naïve, non-traumatized young adults with ADHD compared with healthy controls.

spans.text: We examined whether non-traumatized subjects with Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) have dysfunctional activation in brain structures mediating fear extinction

value: non-traumatized, medication-naïve subjects with ADHD would demonstrate dysfunctional activation in brain structures that mediate fear extinction and learning, consistent with those previously reported in subjects with PTSD

spans.text: We hypothesized that non-traumatized, medication-naïve subjects with ADHD would demonstrate dysfunctional activation in brain structures that mediate fear extinction and learning, consistent with those previously reported in subjects with PTSD

description.value: A controlled, two-day, non-randomized, parallel-group study comparing adults with ADHD and healthy controls during fear conditioning, extinction learning, and extinction recall.
